The OWASP Mobile Top 10 isn't abstract theory — it's the exact list pen testers use to fail your app. Here's the cheat sheet: M1 — stop storing tokens in AsyncStorage, use Keychain/Keystore. M2 — audit your node_modules before it audits you. M3 — biometric gates belong on every sensitive screen, not just login. M4 — parameterize your SQLite queries and validate deep links. M5 — SSL pin your public keys, not your certs, and always have a backup pin. M6 — your crash reporter is exfiltrating PII right now. M7 — enable Hermes, strip source maps, turn off debug mode. M8 — detect jailbreak/root but let your developers bypass it. M9 — encrypt local data with MMKV + Keychain-stored keys. M10 — Math.random() is not random; use expo-crypto.
